subject: Messaging: topics, replies, Codex/Devin delivery
body: New: post --to '#topic' (reaches followers + the task's claimant), reply <msg-id> "body", thread <msg-id>, follow/unfollow <topic>. Message ids now show in brief/inbox. Devin agents now receive messages through the shared .claude hook (brief --json). Codex agents: run /hooks once in this repo to trust .codex/hooks.json. See AGENTS.md section 4.
